note: Preamble 'made this 1st day of April, 2007' is this agreement's dated date; the amendment dates (2008-05-01, 2010-03-31) belong to the amending instruments.
Article 14.1 sets a fifteen-year term from the Effective Date and no calendar end date; Schedule 1's three-/five-year term is also dateless. No arithmetic.

Executed bundle: main Agreement, Schedule 1 (made a part by Article 1.1), Amendments I-II and Amendments I-III to Schedule 1 (each an integral part). Seven names each have a real /s/ block; the label's three are the main block only. Blank Exhibit C and Exhibit G template signature lines excluded.

No registered role word describes the executed parties: 'licensor-licensee' occurs only in the unexecuted Exhibit G model licence (17.5), and Article 5.3.2 grants a licence without using those role tokens. The 'other' fallback is therefore the honest guide answer; the licensing relationship and Amendment II's AU-for-IGER substitution stay as context, not as unsupported role words.

entry.value: Material breach: written notice from the non-breaching Party, then a cure period of thirty (30) days for failures to remit payment and ninety (90) days for all other obligations. One (1) year's written notice by either CERES or IGER if the terminating Party or the other Party ceases substantially all activities in the COLLABORATION CROPS. Thirty (30) days' written notice by IGER on CERES bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership or dissolution, and written notice (no period stated) with a ninety (90) day remedy period if CERES fails to implement the EXHIBIT F activities. By CERES: thirty (30) days' written notice if John Clifton-Brown or Iain Donnison cease to be associated with IGER and are not replaced within one hundred twenty (120) days; ninety (90) days' written notice if IGER's institutional mission, purpose, structure or funding would change substantially and adversely; one (1) year's written notice for a documented compelling business reason to cease the collaboration; three (3) months' prior written notice, not earlier than eighteen (18) months after the Effective Date, if no rights to commercialize the COLLABORATION CROPS germplasm have been secured; and thirty (30) days' written notice if Defra has not assigned or licensed the intellectual property (three (3) years from the Effective Date under Amendment II). Termination also by mutual written agreement, and without a stated notice period if no active RESEARCH PROJECTS exist for more than two (2) years.
